title: Quasi-$F$-splitting versus log canonicity
summary: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between quasi-$F$-splitting and log canonicity. We show that if a numerically $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein normal singularity is quasi-$F^e$-split for every $e\geq 1$, then it is numerically log canonical. In dimension two, we prove the converse under the condition that the Gorenstein index is not divisible by the characteristic $p$. We also classify two-dimensional quasi-$F$-split normal singularities.
